blocks.text: "Presidential" is a song by rap duo YoungBloodZ. It was released in June 2005 as the second single from their third studio album Ev'rybody Know Me. The song peaked at number 81 on the U.S. Billboard Hot 100 chart and number 20 on the U.S. Billboard Hot Rap Tracks chart. An official remix was released on the same album featuring Akon.

Presidential Airways (PAW) is a charter cargo and passenger airline currently based at Melbourne International Airport. Presidential is now a subsidiary of Aviation Worldwide Services, owned by AAR Corp.
